conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for lower monthly returns, focusing on capital preservation. Expect reduced volatility and drawdowns, but also slower growth potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan seeks risk-first growth, targeting moderate monthly returns. It blends index exposure with quality additions and limited leverage, aiming for controlled drawdowns.

Add new positions in SLB and COIN, leveraging strong scanner signals.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets high monthly returns by increasing leverage and concentration in top scanner setups. Expect significantly higher potential upside but also substantially larger drawdowns and amplified losses due to leverage and ETF decay.
